status.summary: Former UFC middleweight champion: he won the interim title from Yoel Romero at UFC 213 (Jul 2017) and lost the title to Israel Adesanya by KO at UFC 243 (Oct 2019). After a submission loss to Khamzat Chimaev (R1, Oct 2024) and a split-decision loss to Reinier de Ridder (Jul 26, 2025), he fought at light heavyweight and knocked out Nikita Krylov at 1:01 of R3 at UFC 329 (Jul 11, 2026), his first UFC fight at 205. UFC record 18-7. Web checks were blocked in this pass, so his ranking, his division plans and any next fight are unverified.

style.summary: A compact, explosive striker who works from range, comes in with fast punches to the head and has finished fights with right hands, head kicks and knees. He has been hard to take down for most of his career. Heavy punchers have dropped him eight times in the UFC, and since 2024 the grapplers have caught up with him. His one UFC fight at light heavyweight, in Jul 2026, ended in a knockout win.

moves.notes: Group shares follow fighters.json decayed sums: sig attempts 87.8% head, 4.6% body, 7.6% leg (career 83.6/7.3/9.1). The middleweight league split is 77.2/14.0/8.8, so he is far more head-focused and throws about a third of the league share to the body. Leg work comes and goes: 28 of 28 vs Costa (Feb 2024), none vs Krylov or De Ridder. 90% of his landed sig is at distance. In the head group the cross and overhand are high because his recent finishes are right hands at distance (Krylov, Aliskerov). The jab and hook are close behind, as a judgment for a blitzing striker. Head kicks get 0.08 because two of his UFC KOs are head kicks at distance (Brunson 2016, Souza 2017), though both are old. The body group leans to kicks as a judgment, since his body attempts are rare and all at distance. Leg weights are an even split because no source in this pass separates calf from inside kicks. The knee gets 0.05 for the Hester clinch-knee TKO. The karate-based, in-and-out style behind the archetype comes from pre-2026 coverage that could not be re-opened in this pass.
